name: Monmusu Fantasy Series - La chica en el bosque
source:
An adventurer is exhausted after his last mission, he asks the gods for a good meal and a girl to have fun with. Along the way he meets a girl from the Cattus species who is preparing a delicious stew.

Did the gods hear his prayer?

[Translated from [url=https://estudios-luna.itch.io/la-chica-en-el-bosque-monmusu-fantasy-series]Itch.io[/url]]
